source.published_structure: individual breeding records with lay date, recruits/fledglings and biotic/abiotic annual variables
source.cue_source: public NOAA/NCEP Ivory Coast daily temperature using the Tomotani 2021 source-defined wintering-ground cue window if reconstructable without outcome tuning

already_known: Ivory Coast and Dutch temperature/NDVI can explain pied-flycatcher arrival timing
those cue variables did not detectably predict the estimated annual male arrival fitness optimum in 2005-2015
climate-driven cue-driver decoupling was explicitly proposed by the authors
prior_art_boundary.payoff_b_question: whether a longer 1980-2010 breeding-fitness driver series shows a time-varying predictive relationship with a biologically prior African cue, without using the known nonlinear selection trajectory to choose regimes

annual_driver.primary: annual standardized linear selection gradient of egg-laying date on number of local recruits
annual_driver.method: reproduce Visser et al. 2015 annual Poisson GLM/gsg-style directional selection estimate as closely as possible from data_breed; if gsg-compatible reproduction is not possible, stop primary lane rather than substitute a differently selected fitness metric
annual_driver.low_recruit_years: use linear-only model in 1981, 1989, 1990, 1991 and 2006, matching the source paper
annual_driver.known_selection_reversal: never used for cue breakpoint selection

cue_coordinate.primary: annual Ivory Coast temperature cue using the source-defined Tomotani 2021 lagged window
cue_coordinate.preferred_window: 20-day mean with 60-day lag relative to the arrival-risk date framework; if the exact annual scalar cannot be reconstructed without individual arrival-risk dates, mark cue scalar NOT_ESTIMABLE and do not tune a new window against selection
cue_coordinate.secondary_if_available: Ivory Coast NDVI using the same source-defined lagged window

predictive_connectivity.processing: within each trailing window ending at t-1, separately linear-detrend cue and annual selection gradient on year, then calculate signed Pearson rho

regime_detection.algorithm: single interior breakpoint minimizing segmented linear SSE
regime_detection.gate: segmented AICc <= linear AICc - 4 and pre/post slopes have opposite signs
regime_detection.recovery_gate: post-break endpoint recovers at least 50% of the pre-break-to-break connectivity decline

history_test_if_reversal_passes.support: interaction 95% CI excludes zero over overlapping connectivity support
history_test_if_reversal_passes.interpretation: within-population cue-driver path dependence only; not interaction-network hysteresis

forbidden_moves: do not choose the 2000/2001 selection reversal as the information breakpoint
do not choose a climate window by maximising correlation with selection
do not replace local recruits with another fitness component after seeing the result
do not call a monotonic cue-driver decline hysteresis
do not promote this single-species lane to network memory
